system.description:
Medium; Lvl 1; Price 200 gp; ACP -2; MAX DEX 5; DR 3; HP 50; Speed 0; Wt. 20 lbs; Traits Full

Among the preferred choices for martial characters seeking agility, the do-maru is the lightest of armours. This protective garment envelops the wearer's form akin to a short, armoured coat. It primarily comprises lamellar components, omitting a solid breastplate or sleeves. While this design leaves the shoulders and upper body somewhat exposed, it affords the wearer an enhanced range of motion compared to many bulkier armour options.

Be aware that this armour is ineffective against critical strikes to the shoulders.

Automated: Full, but not the arms (B9-1): it covers the torso and the legs, so a critical to the arms, where the shoulders are, reads the unarmoured row.
